## What it is

The top clamp. Same disk as the spacer, no pin above it. It keeps the last high cross from lifting off the lap.

## Design notes

- The hole goes through, so there is no ceiling to bridge.
- The hole is the same diamond as the pin. It goes through, so there is no ceiling. It can be printed either face down. A square diamond fits the cap in four rotations; the cap is round, so that does not matter.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't leave the last level uncapped. The high cross is only trapped once this (or a spacer) is on the pin.
